symptom: An action written on an object-list **item** — a chart series' `StaticOnClickAction:`, a popupmenu item's `action:`, a maps marker's `onClick:`, an accordion group's `onToggleCollapsed:` — is accepted by `mxcli check`, the page is written, `mx check` reports 0 errors, and the slot is **empty**. `DESCRIBE` does not mention it either, so nothing reveals the loss
cause: The executor's item-property switch had no `action` case and fell to `default: continue`, carrying `TODO(#538 follow-up)`. Everything under it was already in place — the `.def.json` carries the mapping (`operationForType` returns `"action"`), `backend.ObjectListItemProperty` has an `Action` field, and `widgetobj/builder.go` writes `Value.Action` — so the action reached the AST, matched a mapping, and fell off the end of a switch. `mdl/backend/mcp/widget.go`'s item switch had no `action` case either
insight: **Read the slot through `namedActionSlotValue`, not off the AST's `Action` field.** `microflow M.X` in a property position parses as a **`*DataSourceV3`** — `dataSourceExprV3` wins in `widgetPropertyV3`, deliberately, or a series' `DataSource: microflow M.X` would become an action — so a direct read misses the form people actually write **and** takes the `datasource` branch of the same switch on the way past. Only the widget definition knows the slot is an action. **Three switches, not one**: executor write, DESCRIBE read, MCP builder — patching the first alone gives a page that holds the action and describes as though it does not, which is the lossy round trip wearing the right answer. **A NoAction is the unset default** and must be skipped on read and never written on an unset slot, or every untouched item grows a line and re-exec clears what the widget had. `mx check` is no oracle in either direction — a series with no click action is a normal series, 0 errors before and after; verify by describing back and reading the `.mxunit`. When faking stored BSON in a test, the `$Type` is the **storage** name: `Forms$MicroflowAction`, not `Forms$MicroflowClientAction` (`sdk/mpr/writer_widgets_action.go` is the arbiter) — a wrong one makes the reader silently skip and reads as the fix not working. Issue #956
